about: What this member said on the floor, from the Congressional Record: their own words only, and of those the sentences that name an alignment question's phrases or make a commitment. Written by npm run record:collect (scripts/collect-record.mjs).
name: Jim Jordan

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROPOSING AN AMENDMENT TO THE CONSTITUTION OF THE UNITED STATES TO REQUIRE THAT THE SUPREME COURT OF THE UNITED STATES BE COMPOSED OF NINE JUSTICES
statements.title: PROPOSING AN AMENDMENT TO THE CONSTITUTION OF THE UNITED STATES TO REQUIRE THAT THE SUPREME COURT OF THE UNITED STATES BE COMPOSED OF NINE JUSTICES
sentences: It was on the steps of the United States Supreme Court.
Then, of course, 1 year later, Democrats--not just any Democrats, the chairman of the House Judiciary Committee--introduced the bill to go from 9 to 13, the Court-packing bill.
Then, of course, we had the systematic attacks on two Justices in particular, Justice Alito and Justice Thomas.
Then, of course, we had the real leak, the Dobbs leak, on May 2, 2022.

We mentioned FDR in this context, but in the broader context, the once great party of FDR and JFK is now controlled and is now anti- Israel, socialist, and all kinds of crazy ideas that go to the heart of what our country is about and our Constitution.
We know they want to pack the Court.

We should remember when the Democratic Socialist Mamdani was sworn in as mayor of our largest city 9 months and 2 days ago, he said: ``I was elected as a Democratic Socialist, and I will govern as a Democratic Socialist.'' These are their principles.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROTECTING PRIVACY IN PURCHASES ACT
statements.title: PROTECTING PRIVACY IN PURCHASES ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, you don't give up your Fourth Amendment rights when you are exercising your Second Amendment rights.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: EXTENSION OF AUTHORITIES OF TITLE VII OF THE FOREIGN INTELLIGENCE SURVEILLANCE ACT OF 1978
statements.title: EXTENSION OF AUTHORITIES OF TITLE VII OF THE FOREIGN INTELLIGENCE SURVEILLANCE ACT OF 1978
sentences: The question today is: Can we go another 3 weeks, 21 days, and try to figure out what makes sense on protecting the privacy rights of Americans?
I was willing to go for that, particularly at a time when we, like it or not, are in a conflict, military operation, in Iran.
Mr. Speaker, I will point out to the gentleman from Kentucky, that is not the question today.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SECURE AMERICA ACT
statements.title: SECURE AMERICA ACT
sentences: Open border--let in 10 million.
Second, they create sanctuary jurisdictions, which makes it difficult to remove those migrants when they commit another crime.
Let in 10 million with an open border, create sanctuary jurisdictions-- which, by the way, I always remind folks of this: What is sanctuary jurisdiction?
Politicians telling local law enforcement: Don't work with law enforcement when it comes to enforcing the law.

Some of these prosecutors in these sanctuary jurisdictions, like right over in Virginia in Fairfax County--some of these prosecutors actually take into account the immigration status of someone who has committed a crime when they decide what they are going to charge them with and what kind of plea agreement they are going to have.
Create sanctuary jurisdictions.
Then they said: Oh, we will fund that, but we are not going to fund ICE and CBP.
Now they are saying: We are not going to pay you.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CONCURRENT RESOLUTION ON THE BUDGET FOR FISCAL YEAR 2026
statements.title: CONCURRENT RESOLUTION ON THE BUDGET FOR FISCAL YEAR 2026
sentences: Why would they do that when we have had a third assassination attempt on the President of the United States, while we are in the middle of a military operation in Iran, and when we have had terrorist attacks here on the homeland?
The simple answer is: They don't want a border.
Then, they create sanctuary jurisdictions all over the country, which makes it difficult to remove illegal migrants who commit another crime.
They let in 10 million and create sanctuary jurisdictions.
By the way, 18 cities, 11 States, 3 counties, and the District of Columbia are sanctuary jurisdictions.

Because they are big, blue cities in big, blue States, that represents almost a third of the country that lives in a jurisdiction where the politicians tell local law enforcement not to work with Federal law enforcement when it comes to enforcing Federal law.
That is their plan, and it is all because they don't want a border in our country.
There was an election where the people said we want a border, and that is why this bill and the good work that Chairman Arrington and the Budget Committee have done is so darn important.
They are going to shut the government down for 74 days because they don't want a border.
They create sanctuary jurisdictions so it is difficult to remove them.
Now, we are not going to pay them.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: FALLEN SERVICEMEMBERS RELIGIOUS HERITAGE RESTORATION ACT
statements.title: FALLEN SERVICEMEMBERS RELIGIOUS HERITAGE RESTORATION ACT
sentences: In response to those abuses, Congress enacted the Reforming Intelligence and Securing America Act.
By the way, we do also happen to be in the middle of a military operation in Iran.
The Judiciary Committee will continue to conduct aggressive oversight of FISA, and we will continue to work on some things that we think can be helpful in the future.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR DISPOSITION OF SENATE AMENDMENT TO H.R. 7147, DEPARTMENT OF HOMELAND SECURITY APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2026
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR DISPOSITION OF SENATE AMENDMENT TO H.R. 7147, DEPARTMENT OF HOMELAND SECURITY APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2026
sentences: For 4 years, it was a wide-open border, and 8 million to 10 million people entered this country.
Then, when they got here, leftwing politicians all across the country said: We are going to provide sanctuary for these 8 million to 10 million people who illegally came into the country.
Eighteen cities, 11 States, three counties, and the District of Columbia, representing almost one-third of the population of this Nation, said: We will give sanctuary.
We are going to tell local law enforcement not to work with Federal law enforcement when it comes to the enforcement of Federal law.
ICE sends a detainer there and says: Will you let us know if you are going to let this guy out?
I don't know, but they don't want a border, and they don't want enforcement of our Federal immigration law.

After what they put these ICE agents through on the street, after letting 8 million to 10 million people into the country, and after providing a sanctuary jurisdiction for the bad guys who did what this leader just said in Chicago to this college student, that is what these guys want.
Mr. Speaker, 17,864 times last year, they said: No. We won't work with you.
Mr. Speaker, I urge a ``yes'' vote for this legislation.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: MUHAMMAD ALI AMERICAN BOXING REVIVAL ACT OF 2026
statements.title: MUHAMMAD ALI AMERICAN BOXING REVIVAL ACT OF 2026
sentences: In particular, I thank Representative Jack for the good work he has done shepherding this bill through, and I urge a ``yes'' vote.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DEPORTING FRAUDSTERS ACT OF 2026
statements.title: DEPORTING FRAUDSTERS ACT OF 2026
sentences: First, they were for a wide-open border.

Every single day for 4 years of the Biden administration, people were lining up on the southern border, camping out under the bridges in the various towns along the border, 8 million to 10 million people in a 4-year timeframe.
Then, another position they were for was to abolish ICE.
Third, they are for sanctuary jurisdictions.

Mr. Speaker, 31\1/2\ percent of the population of this country resides in a jurisdiction where leftwing political leaders tell local law enforcement not to work with Federal law enforcement when it comes to enforcing Federal law.

Last year alone, 17,864 times a detainer was filed at the local jail, local detention center, when an illegal migrant was in that facility and charged with another crime, and ICE files a detainer and says: If you are going to let him out, give us a heads-up.
Mr. Speaker, the final one: If you find some fraudster who is a naturalized citizen and rips off the taxpayers, you can't deport them.
They are, like, no, we are not going to deport them.
We are going to give them, as the chairman said, sanctuary here in the country.
These are the most ridiculous positions: open border, abolish ICE, sanctuary jurisdiction, and don't deport fraudsters who are here.
We will come to apprehend the individual there in the jail so we don't have to do it on the street where our agents are going to be spit on, harassed, sworn at, and attacked.
Mr. Speaker, I thank Mr. Taylor and our chairman, Mr. McClintock, for the great work they have done on this legislation, and I urge a ``yes'' vote.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: MEDAL OF SACRIFICE ACT OF 2025
statements.title: MEDAL OF SACRIFICE ACT OF 2025
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I move to suspend the rules and pass the bill (H.R. 3497) to establish a medal of service for law enforcement officers and first responders, as amended.
Mr. Speaker, H.R. 3497, the Medal of Sacrifice Act of 2025, honors law enforcement officers and other first responders who are killed in the line of duty.
This bill authorizes the President to award a medal to those law enforcement officers and first responders.
Law enforcement officers and other first responders courageously face danger to protect American communities.
While others may flee, law enforcement and first responders run toward crises.
Law enforcement officers uphold public safety by enforcing laws and maintaining order.
Some law enforcement and first responders make the ultimate sacrifice in serving their communities.
In 2024, the FBI reported that 64 law enforcement personnel were murdered while on duty.
That same year, another 56 law enforcement officers died because of traffic-related incidents.
No. H.R. 3497 would create a medal for officers employed by state, local, or tribal law enforcement agencies who are killed in the line of duty.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: EPSTEIN FILES TRANSPARENCY ACT
statements.title: EPSTEIN FILES TRANSPARENCY ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I move to suspend the rules and pass the bill (H.R. 4405) to require the Attorney General to release all documents and records in possession of the Department of Justice relating to Jeffrey Epstein, and for other purposes.
Democrats have spent 6 months talking about Epstein, even though they had 4 years to do something about it.

By the way, the same party that did all that, they were also the ones who were texting with Mr. Epstein during a hearing where Michael Cohen was their witness in another effort to go after the President.
President Trump said he would secure the border, and he did.
President Trump said he would make sure Iran doesn't have nuclear capability, and he did.
President Trump said he would get the hostages out of Gaza and back into Israel, and he did.
The Democrats released an email that the Oversight Committee had obtained from the estate, an email from Mr. Epstein to Ms. Maxwell.

In an email between two criminals, Mr. Epstein and Ms. Maxwell, they hide the name of an individual who had went public and exonerated the President, and we know why: to distort and twist the message because they thought it might harm the President.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: RESCISSIONS ACT OF 2025
statements.title: RESCISSIONS ACT OF 2025
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I urge a ``yes'' vote.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
statements.title: ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, my colleagues know it is a good bill because the left hates it--the left that defunded the police; the left that let 10 million people illegally enter our country in a 4-year time span; the left that wants men to compete against women in sports; the left that lied to us about Benghazi, lied to us about the Hunter Biden laptop, lied to us about President Biden's health; and the left that lied to us about COVID.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: EXPRESSING SUPPORT FOR LOCAL LAW ENFORCEMENT OFFICERS
statements.title: EXPRESSING SUPPORT FOR LOCAL LAW ENFORCEMENT OFFICERS
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I move to suspend the rules and agree to the concurrent resolution (H. Con. Res. 30) expressing support for local law enforcement officers.
Mr. Speaker, this week, we celebrate National Police Week.
More than 60 years ago, President John F. Kennedy signed a proclamation that designated May 15 as Peace Officers Memorial Day and the week in which that day falls as Police Week.
Thousands of law enforcement officers are visiting Washington, D.C., this week to honor their colleagues who have made the ultimate sacrifice.
I extend my sincere gratitude to all local law enforcement officers and their families for their sacrifice and their service.
These police officers risk their lives every day to protect our communities, and they do this despite the obstacles and dangers that we all know that they face.

Police officers rush into harm's way out of duty and devotion to their sacred oath: ``To Protect and Serve.'' The families of law enforcement officers also bear the burden of service through missed birthdays, school events, and sports games.
I encourage all Members to take time to pray, show their support for, and say thank you to our local law enforcement heroes.
I thank the gentleman from Mississippi (Mr. Ezell), who served in law enforcement as a sheriff, for his work in putting this together and sponsoring the resolution.
Mr. Speaker, let's be clear: Republicans honor local law enforcement, Democrats defund them.
That is all you would hear from Democrats, got to defund the local police.
We have condemned violence every single time it happened whether it was January 6 or the summer of 2020.
They spent the whole summer trying to defund the police, so don't give us the lecture.

Mr. Speaker, I yield such time as he may consume to the gentleman from Mississippi (Mr. Ezell), the fine gentleman who served in local law enforcement, who was a sheriff, and who knows what it is like to go out there and protect his community, for sponsoring this resolution.
Let me just read off the Democratic-run cities that did defund the police.
All during the summer of 2020, they were saying: Defund the police.
Now they say: Oh, but because crime went up when we defunded the police, we want Federal taxpayers to send us money to make up for the cuts we did there and spent the money elsewhere.
However, don't say you didn't defund the police.
For the bad guys who harmed the police that summer when you were encouraging cities to cut the police, you were raising money to bail them out.
We respect the police and want it done right.
We are for honoring local police, like this good sheriff, this Member of Congress, and what they do day in and day out.
We all do appreciate the work of our law enforcement men and women who put that uniform on every day, risk their lives to protect our families, our communities, all the things that we care about.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to support this resolution.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: NO ROGUE RULINGS ACT OF 2025
statements.title: NO ROGUE RULINGS ACT OF 2025
sentences: They are not the person who put his name on the ballot and ran nationwide, got 77 million votes, won the electoral college, and is head of the executive branch.
We just got two decisions from the United States Supreme Court who seemed to reinforce that fundamental principle that the guy who runs and heads the executive branch makes the decision.
The Supreme Court said 2 days ago that they are going to put a hold on the time on this Judge Boasberg and this migrant issue that has been with us for the last 3 weeks.

Then, yesterday, this unelected district judge in California who thinks they get to decide how many probationary employees work in the executive branch, not the guy who heads the executive branch, the Supreme Court said ``no'' to that, those leftwing groups who were seeking standing in that case.
Mr. Speaker, I urge adoption of the legislation.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CONCURRENT RESOLUTION ON THE BUDGET FOR FISCAL YEAR 2025
statements.title: CONCURRENT RESOLUTION ON THE BUDGET FOR FISCAL YEAR 2025
sentences: Mr. Chairman, the budget resolution will allow us to cut taxes, reduce spending, help our national defense, and secure the border, which is exactly what we told the voters we were going to do in the election.
To do all of that, it takes resources, particularly the one that focuses in our committee on securing the border.
It takes resources, and the reason we need so many resources to secure the border is because the previous administration screwed everything up so badly.
Day one of the Biden administration, they made three decisions: no more building the wall, no more remain in Mexico, and when migrants get here, they will not be detained but will be released.
It takes lawyers to secure that border and handle what needs to be done to fix what Democrats caused and created.
I want to reduce spending because I know we are running deficits in the trillions, and we have piled up $36 trillion in debt.
I just got back from Israel last week.
Mr. Chairman, I urge a ``yes'' vote, and I thank the chairman again for his good work and his committee's work.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: AGENT RAUL GONZALEZ OFFICER SAFETY ACT
statements.title: AGENT RAUL GONZALEZ OFFICER SAFETY ACT
sentences: They actually tried to set up the Disinformation Governance Board as if a bunch of Federal bureaucrats can tell us what we can say, what we can't say, what is information, and what is disinformation.
After all, we have a $36 trillion debt.
I will trust the guy who was elected by 77 million Americans.
I will trust the Constitution that says: The executive power shall be vested in a President of the United States.
